A.notes: Solid compact engine; all rules tested. Real bug: defender reply is a bare setTimeout never cleared (src/main.ts, diff.patch:563-573); switching puzzle within 550 ms runs step++ and a reply on the new puzzle, corrupting it. Tapping the selected piece reselects instead of deselecting. render() rebuilds innerHTML each time. Visual: clean modals, but desktop left-aligned and sparse, tiny coordinates, select-only picker.

B.notes: Correct puzzle flow: replyTimer is cleared on startPlay/openPuzzle, alternative final mate accepted, selection limited to the player side. e2e solves every puzzle; insufficient material includes same-colour bishops (unasked). Code weaker: render() rebuilds the whole app innerHTML including tabs on every render (src/main.ts). Visual is plain: result card in side panel, desktop slightly left-aligned, select plus buttons.

C.notes: Clear engine and thorough rule tests (36). Same stale-timer bug as A: puzzle reply setTimeout (src/main.ts, diff.patch:542-550) is never stored or cleared; startPuzzle does not cancel it, so a quick puzzle switch plays a reply and step++ on the new puzzle. Has Undo and compact solved card. Visual adequate but plain: status text below the board, little hierarchy.

D.notes: Modular engine/ui split, timers tracked and cleared (src/ui/app.ts, diff.patch:1706-1713). Unit test proves all 12 puzzle solutions legal and mating; 69 unit tests incl. castling-rights repetition. Wrong puzzle move is actually played then undone after 700 ms (diff.patch:1817-1825), briefly showing an illegal-for-the-puzzle position. Only 4 e2e tests. Polished both themes: move list, puzzle grid, game-over modal with View board.

E.notes: Timers tracked and cleared (src/main.ts, diff.patch:540-550); final move accepts any mate. Tests cover each rule, plus puzzle count. No real bugs found. Visual is the weak point: redundant panels ('Puzzle solved' plus 'Solved!', 'Checkmate' plus 'Game over'), and the queen SVG is a crude crown next to the other pieces.

F.notes: Defender reply played synchronously with an animation delay (src/main.ts, diff.patch:1000-1015), so no timer race; wrong move undone and flashed, wrongTimer cleared. 53 unit tests plus 15 e2e including CDP touch tap/drag, threefold and castling via UI. Most polished UI: blurred modals, move list, puzzle grid with solved ticks, hint, promotion cancel; good at both widths and themes.

G.notes: Same stale-timer bug as A: reply window.setTimeout (src/main.ts, diff.patch:655-660) is not stored; resetTransient only clears wrongTimer, so switching puzzle mid-reply corrupts the new puzzle. No unit test that check is detected (describe 'check, mate, stalemate' at diff.patch:1351 tests only mate, stalemate, undo). Visual: promotion picker without title or cancel, duplicate status line and two New game buttons on game over.

X.notes: Reply timer cleared on puzzle open (src/main.ts, diff.patch:1060); accepts any move that still forces mate via defenderLost search (src/chess.ts, diff.patch:668), the most correct puzzle judging. e2e solves every puzzle and drags with a finger. The search adds complexity but is contained. Visual polished: status bar, move list, puzzle grid, solved modal naming the move.

Y.notes: Modular engine/ui; reply timer cleared in openPuzzle and Play tab (src/ui/app.ts, diff.patch:1329, 1404). Wrong move undone with SAN message. 65 unit tests incl. SAN disambiguation (an extra that powers the move list). An alternative mate on move one of a mate-in-2 is rejected (diff.patch:1356), minor. Visual good with move list and grid, but the solved state is only a line of text.

Z.notes: Uncancellable async wait(450) for the defender reply (src/main.ts, diff.patch:624-636) captures the old puzzle p but the global game and solIdx, so switching puzzle mid-reply does solIdx++ and may mark the new puzzle solved. Fewest tests (21 unit, 6 e2e). Visual minimal: small ~415 px board on a sparse 1280 px page, no Flip or Undo, only a New game button.
